mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.2 percentage points from the prior month signals labor market deterioration, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days due to earnings concerns.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.2pp, or Rank IC remains below 0.01 over 2-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicate broad demand contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through recessionary expectations.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline from prior month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or joint Rank IC falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: During manufacturing supply chain disruption (INDPRO decline for 3 months), S&P 500 underperforms due to inflationary pressures and margin compression, yielding negative returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of INDPRO decline periods, or Rank IC for the regime falls below 0.01.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.0% signals persistent inflation, prompting Fed tightening that reduces equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0% periods, or Rank IC remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained 6-month growth in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates labor market strength supporting consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of PAYEMS growth periods, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 5-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions (GDPC1 annual growth > 3.0%), a decline in residential construction (HOUST) signals economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of HOUST decline instances during GDPC1 > 3.0% growth, or regime-specific Rank IC < 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous industrial production decline (INDPRO) and unemployment rate increase (UNRATE) indicate dual supply-labor market shocks, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO declines and UNRATE rises from prior month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of dual shock instances, or joint Rank IC falls below 0.01.
